name: JellymountPlus
description: Cinematic dark theme for Jellyfin Web 12.1 — near-black surfaces, dense poster rails, restyled detail pages and player OSD. Optional extras layer adds a home hero and hover previews.
overview: Applies the JellymountPlus theme via Jellyfin Branding custom CSS; theme assets are served by the plugin itself.

versions.changelog: Initial release — theme applied via Branding Custom CSS, assets served by the plugin. Optional extras: home hero, featured selector, hover previews, badges.
